claim: A fixed supervised multi-view sequence model may be evaluated for predictive reconstruction and identity-free nearest-view retrieval on independent lossy views of unseen finite predictive objects, using exact frozen target signatures and full-observation-horizon-matched test pairs.

object_family.kind: minimal strongly connected four-state binary unifilar process
object_family.canonicalization: lexicographically minimal machine tuple over all 24 state permutations
object_family.minimality_witness: all four state-conditioned exact word-probability signatures through length eight are distinct
object_family.object_equivalence: identical exact uniform-start word-probability vectors for lengths one through eight

exclusions.machine_hashes: exclude every machine_sha256 in every v0 manifest split row
exclusions.predictive_signature_hashes: exclude every length1_to_8 predictive signature hash in every v0 manifest split row

frozen_splits.selection: canonicalize and deduplicate the full ufpo-v1 counter interval, exclude every v0 machine and length1-to-8 predictive-signature hash, sort eligible machine SHA-256 hashes, take the first 128 train and next 32 validation objects, then the next 32 test objects
frozen_splits.test_pairing_distance: exact minimum-weight perfect matching over the test 32 using full lengths one through twelve predictive-signature L1 distance
frozen_splits.test_use: one sealed evaluation after source, manifest, thresholds, controls, and training protocol are committed

view_process.initial_state: independent uniform draw for every trajectory
view_process.independence: every view uses a disjoint SHA-256-derived PRNG subtree; no latent trajectory, initial-state draw, mask, or corruption draw is shared

learner.pooling: DeepSets mean over independently encoded trajectories
learner.decoder: separate softmax segment for each target word length one through eight
learner.loss: equal-weight predictive cross entropy plus InfoNCE over independent same-object views at temperature 0.1
learner.checkpoint_policy: score epoch 16 only; no early stopping or test-aware selection

engine_contract.registry_proposal_owner: Python stdlib Fraction generator freezes candidate enumeration, canonical records, v0 exclusions, splits, exact signatures, and full-observation-horizon-matched pair distances; it does not own predictive-object semantics
engine_contract.julia: independent exact Rational semantic verification and arbitration
engine_contract.jax: Python/JAX x64 exact-numerator, view-generation, leakage, and solver workhorse; Python canonicalization is not relabeled as JAX semantics
engine_contract.pytorch: supervised multi-view GRU/DeepSets prediction and nearest-view retrieval with frozen controls
engine_contract.semantic_owner: Julia independent exact finite predictive-equivalence verification and arbitration
engine_contract.jacrev: supportive only; never a semantic arbiter or primary gate

blocked_consumers: QIT engine stages or four-substage derivation
Axis0, FEP, physics, life, or consciousness
